            '            ExpenseAttentionScreen(items: items, permissions: _permissions),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _openReceiptDrafts() {\n'

            '    Navigator.of(context).push(\n'

            '        builder: (_) => ExpenseReceiptDraftsScreen(permissions: _permissions),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _openScheduledExpenses() {\n'
            '    if (!_permissions.canManageScheduledExpenses) return;\n'
            '    Navigator.of(context).push(\n'
            '      MaterialPageRoute<void>(\n'
            '        builder: (_) => ScheduledExpensesScreen(permissions: _permissions),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _addScheduledExpense() async {\n'
            '    if (!_permissions.canManageScheduledExpenses) return;\n'
            '    final record = await Navigator.of(context).push<ScheduledExpenseRecord>(\n'
            '      MaterialPageRoute(\n'
            '        builder: (_) => ScheduledExpenseEditorScreen(\n'
            '          permissions: _permissions,\n'
            '          onConfirm: RecurringExpenseUiScope.maybeOf(context)?.create,\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ),\n'

            '        PrototypeOperationsScope.of(\n'

            '  void _openExpense(ExpenseRecord expense) => Navigator.of(context).push(\n'
            '    MaterialPageRoute<void>(\n'
